title: Protein digestion begins
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: Pepsin acts in the acidic stomach to break proteins into smaller polypeptides. Protein digestion continues in the small intestine.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: In which organ does pepsin begin breaking dietary proteins into smaller peptides? Pepsin acts in the acidic stomach to break proteins into smaller polypeptides. Protein digestion continues in the small intestine.
